caseName: Insurance Co. of Pennsylvania v. Ben Cooper, Inc.
caseNameFull: INSURANCE COMPANY OF THE STATE OF PENNSYLVANIA v. BEN COOPER, INC.

opinions.text: The motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument is granted to be divided as follows: 80 minutes for petitioners; 20 minutes for respondent; and 10 minutes for the Solicitor General. The request for additional time for oral argument is denied.
